text: Monitors should only be connected to networks explicitly intended for patient monitoring. Facilities must implement network traffic isolation using dedicated physical or logical networks (isolated VLANs) and firewalls to limit remote access.
ECG Leads Off / Lead Malfunction: Check electrode skin contact, lead wire integrity, and ensure proper cable snap connections to the trunk cable.
NBP Pneumatic Leak: Perform a leak test using a test lung. Inspect cuff tubing, connectors, and internal pneumatic valves for cracks or loose fittings.

Battery Low / Failure INOP: If the smart battery fails to charge or shows capacity errors, check contacts, verify AC power input, and run a battery calibration cycle. Replace lithium-ion battery packs that fail capacity thresholds.
SpO2 Sensor Malf: Try another adapter cable and sensor. If the INOP persists, contact your service personnel.

Alarm Limits Configuration: High and low alarm limits can be customized per parameter (ECG, SpO2, NBP). To adjust alarm thresholds, select the parameter numeric, enter the Alarm Setup menu, and adjust the High Limit / Low Limit bounds. Ensure alarm volumes are set to audible levels according to hospital policy.
